text: Agile methodology is a modern way of managing projects, especially in software development. Instead of planning everything at once, teams work in short cycles called sprints, which usually last two to four weeks. Before each sprint, the team chooses tasks from a prioritised list called the backlog. These tasks are often written as user stories, simple descriptions of what a user needs. Every day, the team holds a short meeting called a standup to share progress and problems. This iterative development approach helps teams adapt to changes quickly, deliver working results regularly, and improve continuously based on feedback.
